name: portafolio
description: Portafolio de José Francisco Quevedo Hernández (sitio estático + funciones en Vercel)

scripts.obfuscate: npm run obfuscate:app && npm run obfuscate:admin
scripts.obfuscate:app: npx javascript-obfuscator app.src.js --output app.min.js --compact true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 0.8 --split-strings false --transform-object-keys false --debug-protection false
scripts.obfuscate:admin: npx javascript-obfuscator admin.src.js --output admin.min.js --compact true --identifier-names-generator hexadecimal --string-array true --string-array-encoding base64 --string-array-threshold 0.8 --split-strings false --transform-object-keys false --debug-protection false
